newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares ease on profit-taking, higher rates.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares ease on profit-taking, higher rates.

text.p: Istanbul stocks fell on Tuesday in strong profit-taking led by state firms amid rising rates in Treasury's bill auction, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 which brushed a trading record of 2,065 in the morning session, closed 33 points, or 1.62 percent lower at 2,003. It had jumped 3.19 percent on Monday.
Daily trade volume eased to 28.89 trillion lira from Monday's 29.36 trillion.
"Results of the treasury auction had raised concerns among brokers because interest rates were higher than expected," said Gokhan Kolay from Polen Securities.
